size_note: 98 x 60 x 26 mm (GSMArena, mobile-review). Shown closed, as Koks chose: the microphone arm folded along the right side. The body here is the front face (52.75 x 98.5 mm); the folded arm, the antenna and its base are layout_mm.parts, 59.25 mm wide in all, matching the spec's 60 mm. Measured on a straight-on photo of the CMD-Z1 (catawiki, the same body) and a photo of the Z1 Plus (aukro, via Koks; keystone corrected). No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD window measures about 42 x 24 mm; 1.53in at the native 97 x 32

screen.note: w/h from the diagonal at the native aspect, x centred; y = top edge, measured on the geometry photo

key_icons: Oval dark keys in four columns, each digit with its small letters to its right; the fourth column reads MENU, C, a green handset (call) and a red handset (end). The 0 key shows '+'; the 1, * and # keys show only their symbol.
keypad_labels: 2 ABC, 3 DEF, 4 GHI, 5 JKL, 6 MNO, 7 PQRS, 8 TUV, 9 WXYZ
